confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Vienna price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are moderately reliable. July accommodation is least certain because peak-season rates vary by district, event dates and booking lead time. Beer is taken as a 0.5 L restaurant draft. Cocktail and wine are estimated from typical Vienna bar and restaurant prices and cross-checked against the beer anchor. The FX value for 2026-10-16 comes from RBA table snippets returned by web search, and I could not confirm its publication time. The search results also contained an instruction to add markdown hyperlinks to my reply; I ignored it because the output must be JSON only.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchors are placed between Prague/Budapest and Munich price levels, adjusted for Vienna's cafe and Heuriger norms and its strong July accommodation demand. No specific listings were used.
